description: This file defines the GuestSession class within the aidl::android::hardware::confirmationui namespace. It manages confirmation UI sessions, including message handling, session state, and interaction with hardware authentication tokens. The class provides methods for prompting user confirmation, delivering secure input events, aborting sessions, and managing message queues.

classes.name: GuestSession
classes.description: Manages a confirmation UI session, including message queue, session state, and interaction with hardware tokens and UI prompts.

methods.name: PromptUserConfirmation
methods.description: Initiates a user confirmation prompt and returns the result as a tuple containing status and message data.

methods.name: DeliverSecureInputEvent
methods.description: Delivers a secure input event using a hardware authentication token.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts the current session, cleaning up resources and stopping ongoing interactions.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Pushes a message into the incoming message queue.
